title: Chateau Elan Golf Club
gap: Price for Executive Par 3 Course not stated
blurb: Chateau Elan Winery & Resort is a luxury destination in North Georgia featuring world-class accommodations, award-winning wines, exceptional dining, a European-inspired spa, and 45 holes of championship golf including two 18-hole courses and a unique Par 3 course. The resort spans 3,500 scenic acres of vineyard, countryside, and pine forest. Guests can enjoy a variety of activities including golf, wellness, and culinary experiences.
